_comment: COPY THIS TO data/vote/sites.json AND FILL IT IN. With no sites.json there are no sites: the Vote clerk says voting is not set up yet and nothing pretends to check. Everything else - the ledger, the tickets, the shop - is built and works today.
_comment_id: id goes in the callback URL and into the ledger for ever. Do not rename it once votes have been credited under it, or their cooldowns and duplicate checks start again from nothing.
name: Example Toplist
_comment_playerurl: THE SAME PAGE WITH THE PLAYER'S NAME IN IT, {user} marking where it goes. Leave it out and the Vote clerk hands every player a link that names nobody: the vote counts toward your ranking and can never pay a ticket, because a site only tells you who voted if you told it first. Some sites take a path segment and some a query parameter - read the site's incentive-voting docs for which, and for what it sends back.
_comment_callback: THE SITE CALLS US. Give the site <your server>/vote/example/callback as its callback or postback URL. secretParam/userParam/refParam are what the site calls those things in its request - read its docs. The secret is never written here: put it in the environment and name it.
_comment_resetparam: resetParam names the field the site puts the NEXT ALLOWED VOTE TIME in, if it sends one. Set it wherever it exists, because it beats cooldownHours: a site's window need not be a rolling one. RSPS List sends 'reset' and its rule is the next noon or midnight, so a vote at 11:55 is followed by another at noon - and cooldownHours would have said twelve hours. Unix seconds, unix milliseconds or any ordinary date string are all understood; anything else is logged and ignored, and the vote still counts.
_comment_check: WE CALL THE SITE, when a player clicks Claim. {user} and {key} are substituted. success says how to read a yes out of the answer: either "contains" with a substring, or "json" with a dotted path and "equals". refJson is where the site puts its own id for the vote, if it sends one - without it, one claim per cooldown window is the most anybody can get.
